description:
§42.3.5 worked example `${ given @user :> {

${@user.name}

} }` on a `User | not` CELL: after a click sets @user present, the guarded markup body renders the narrowed cell's field, and a handler's `given @user :> { … }` body runs. Pre-s461 impl#1 lowered the cell head to an undeclared bare JS name (ReferenceError at load and on click) and dropped the markup body.
rationale:
§42.3.5 worked example: `${ given @user :> {

${@user.name}

} } // OK — narrowed to present inside the guard`. §42.2.3: "Inside the body, each named variable is narrowed — the `| not` component is removed from each variable's type. No variable is rebound to a new name; each identifier is narrowed in place." §42.5: `given x :> body` → `if (x !== null && x !== undefined) { body }` — the presence test reads the variable named, here the cell.
